name: Long-track tornado environment
description: Very strong deep-layer flow + concentrated low-level helicity + buoyancy + low LCL — distinguishes long-track from generic tornadic environments. WFO Louisville tip sheet (Long Track Tornadoes): 0-1 SRH ~261 m²/s², 0-8 km shear ≥ 60-70 kt, 500 mb jet ~75 kt, MLCAPE supportive, low LCL. 0-6 km shear is used here as a 0-8 proxy. Starting point — tune across cycles.
